chars.ILYAS: ILYAS: a 24-year-old Moroccan man with short black curly hair and light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black joggers and white sneakers
chars.GAWRI: GAWRI: a tall blond European tourist man about 30, long blond hair tied in a bun, wearing a red-and-white checked shirt over a white t-shirt, beige shorts, round sunglasses pushed up on his head
chars.BANDITS: BANDITS: a gang of men with faces fully hidden by dark olive balaclavas, wearing brown hooded wool djellabas over dark clothes

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: ILYAS and GAWRI ride a red quad bike up a steep dirt trail into a dense pine forest in the Rif mountains above Chefchaouen, blue houses far below; GAWRI drives laughing, ILYAS behind him looks uneasy; in the shadows between trees a hooded silhouette watches them

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: ILYAS and GAWRI speeding on the red quad bike along a mountain forest track, dust flying, both grinning with excitement, cedar and pine trees, sunny afternoon

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: ILYAS and GAWRI sitting relaxed on a rock in a quiet empty forest clearing, the red quad parked nearby, GAWRI leaning back with closed eyes enjoying the calm, ILYAS chatting

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: a big stone smashes violently into the pine tree right next to ILYAS and GAWRI in the forest clearing, bark and splinters flying, both jump up in shock, eyes wide, turning their heads

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: five BANDITS step out from between the trees surrounding ILYAS and GAWRI in the forest clearing, ILYAS and GAWRI frozen in fear back to back, tense standoff

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: BANDITS grab ILYAS and GAWRI by the arms and shoulders and force them down to their knees on the forest ground, both struggling and terrified

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: GAWRI kneeling on the forest floor shaking and pale with terror, hands raised, ILYAS kneeling next to him looking at him in panic, BANDITS standing over them

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: one BANDIT raises a large machete high above kneeling ILYAS in the dark forest, ILYAS looks up in horror, dramatic low angle, no blood
